ADDED i3: Measured in DAYS: exact day difference, can be zero or negative.
ADDED i4: Measured in WEEKS: whole 7-day weeks only.
ADDED i5: Measured in MONTHS: whole months only; same day-of-month one month later is 1.
ADDED i6: Measured in YEARS: whole years only.
ADDED i7: Measured in DECADES: whole 10-year spans only.
ADDED i8: Measured in CENTURIES: whole 100-year spans only.
ADDED i9: Measured in MILLENNIA: whole 1000-year spans only.
ADDED i10: Measured in ERAS: both dates share the same (CE) era, so the distance is 0.
